brief:
UNRWA faces internal threats through administrative decisions that undermine its operations and separate its workforce, Shehab Wire reported. The agency confronts risks from within that may prove more damaging than external targeting, according to an analysis examining how internal dismantling could jeopardize its functions.

The report suggests that institutional erosion poses a critical challenge to UNRWA's ability to serve Palestinian refugees, with internal structural decisions potentially compromising the agency's core mission and staff capacity.

title: Administrative decisions weaken UNRWA from within, agency analysis warns
